mapper.sql: id, person_id, type, rel_path, file_name, ext, file_size, width, height, modified_at, file_created_at, created_at

choose.when: ORDER BY file_size DESCASC, file_name ASC, id ASC
ORDER BY (width IS NULL OR width = 0 OR height IS NULL OR height = 0) ASC, COALESCE(width, 0) * COALESCE(height, 0) DESCASC, file_name ASC, id ASC
ORDER BY (file_created_at IS NULL) ASC, file_created_at DESCASC, file_name ASC, id ASC
ORDER BY (modified_at IS NULL) ASC, modified_at DESCASC, file_name ASC, id ASC
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY file_name DESCASC, id ASC

mapper.insert:
INSERT IGNORE INTO media (person_id, type, rel_path, file_name, ext, file_size, width, height, modified_at, file_created_at) VALUES
(#{m.personId}, #{m.type}, #{m.relPath}, #{m.fileName}, #{m.ext}, #{m.fileSize}, #{m.width}, #{m.height}, #{m.modifiedAt}, #{m.fileCreatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media WHERE person_id = #{personId} AND type = #{type}

SELECT m.id, m.person_id, m.type, m.rel_path, m.file_name, m.ext, m.file_size, m.width, m.height, m.modified_at, m.file_created_at, m.created_at, p.media_dir AS mediaDir FROM media m JOIN person p ON p.id = m.person_id WHERE m.modified_at IS NULL OR m.file_created_at IS NULL OR (m.type = 'PHOTO' AND (m.width IS NULL OR m.width = 0)) LIMIT 1000
